name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A single-selection text-alignment group: three icon toggles share one group value so pressing an alignment activates it and releases the others, with 'left' pre-pressed via defaultValue.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — group state held internally, initialized with defaultValue={['left']} (single selection)
nonTrivialInteractions: Single-selection shared state: pressing one toggle releases the previously pressed one (no multiple prop), every child's pressed state driven by the group's single value array
defaultValue={['left']} pre-presses the Align left toggle on mount
Pressed styling is driven by the data-pressed attribute Toggle receives from the shared group state
Each Toggle is identified to the group by its value prop; the group is labeled via aria-label

name: multiple
whatItDemonstrates: A multi-press text-formatting group: the multiple prop lets bold/italic/underline be toggled independently and stay pressed simultaneously, with bold and italic pre-pressed via defaultValue.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — group state held internally, initialized with defaultValue={['bold', 'italic']} with multiple enabled
nonTrivialInteractions: multiple prop lets several toggles stay pressed at once — pressing Underline keeps Bold and Italic pressed
defaultValue={['bold', 'italic']} pre-presses two toggles on mount
Pressed styling is driven by the data-pressed attribute Toggle receives from the shared group state
Each Toggle is identified to the group by its value prop; the group is labeled via aria-label
